title: THE CORE VORTICITY -- the negative inner beta as angular momentum: the phantom's spin from the infall. (1) rotation interpretation of beta_inner = -0.10 (sigma_t/sigma_r, v_rot/sigma_r, the angular-momentum budget); (2) the infall source (G182: j_infall = b v_ff, b_req, the transferred fraction, the phase-mixing tension); (3) the signature test: the projected v_los gradient at the core bins from the committed HeCS v_los (per-cluster fit, shuffle-null, amplitude + aligned + Rayleigh statistics); (4) verdicts V1/V2/V3

upstream.G209: beta_inner(0.5-1.5 R500) = -0.0994 +- 0.0736 (E2-primary free 2D piecewise; the isothermal upper edge 0.2 excluded at -4.1 sigma)
upstream.Z7: core sigma_r from the committed inversion: 859 / 829 km/s at 0.707 / 1.225 R500 (E2-primary beta); m_ph = 5.09 keV = 9.074e-33 kg

verdicts.V1: IMPLIED ANGULAR MOMENTUM: anisotropy reading sigma_t/sigma_r = 1.049 +- 0.035 (a 4.8% tangential excess, 1.38 sigma from isotropic); ordered-rotation reading v_rot = 376 +- 139 km/s -> j_core = 2.24e+05 kpc.km/s (6.9e+27 m^2/s per unit mass); L = N m r v_tan = 6.36e-01 kg m^2/s (10,145 catalog) / 1.97e-01 (shell N = 3146).  The comparable number is the specific j; the SI L is small because m = 5.09 keV is a particle-scale mass.
verdicts.V2: INFALL-TRANSFER BALANCE: the infall CAN supply the beta-implied spin to order unity (b_req = 1.32 R500, a plausible stream impact parameter; f(b=1 R500) = 132%); the DIRECT measurement closes the balance: core gradient excess 30 +- 24 km/s per R500 (z = 1.3) -> measured j = 1.5e+04 +- 1.2e+04 kpc.km/s (2-sigma UL 3.9e+04) vs j_infall = 1.7e+05 kpc.km/s at 1 R500 -> transferred fraction f = 0.09 (UL 0.23): stream available, spin not deposited; the ordered component would need to survive phase-mixing at 2.7 x sigma_d.
verdicts.V3: THE HONEST STATEMENT -- the phantom core's spin, measured: the projected v_los gradient at the core bins [0.2, 1.5] R500 (3146 HeCS members, 58 clusters) is 30.5 +- 23.6 km/s per R500 over the shuffle-null (z = 1.29); projected rotation amplitude v_rot,los = 25.9 +- 20.0 km/s (2-sigma UL 65.9 km/s), axis uniform (Rayleigh z = 0.79), aligned component null-consistent (z = 0.66) -- CONSISTENT WITH ZERO.  The beta_inner = -0.10 rotation reading (v_rot = 376 km/s -> A_pred = 348 km/s per R500) is EXCLUDED at >10 sigma by the direct kinematics; the negative inner beta reads as mild tangential dispersion anisotropy (sigma_t/sigma_r = 1.05), not ordered spin; the infall's angular momentum is geometrically sufficient but kinematically undeposited.
